title: Emails & Correspondence
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has aprendido el vocabulario esencial para escribir y gestionar correos electrónicos formales en inglés.

parts.visual:
Partes de un correo: Subject (Asunto). Attachment (Archivo adjunto). Recipient (Destinatario). 
Acciones: Reply (Responder). Reply all (Responder a todos). Forward (Reenviar). Attach (Adjuntar). CC (Con copia).
parts.audio: Parts of an email. Subject. Attachment. Recipient. Actions: Reply. Reply all. Forward means to send an email you received to another person. Attach means to add a file. CC stands for Carbon Copy.

parts.visual:
Frases útiles: Please find attached... (Por favor, encuentre adjunto...). I am writing to inform you that... (Le escribo para informarle que...). 
Despedidas formales: Sincerely, / Best regards, (Atentamente / Saludos cordiales).
parts.audio: Useful phrases. Please find attached the report. I am writing to inform you that the meeting is delayed. Formal sign-offs: Sincerely, or Best regards.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta relacionada con correos electrónicos y correspondencia.

questions.question: What is the ____ of the email? (Asunto).
Please ____ the document to the email. (Adjuntar).
Please find ____ the report you requested. (Adjunto).
questions.explanation: Please find attached = por favor, encuentre adjunto.

questions.question: Don't forget to ____ to his email. (Responder).
questions.explanation: Reply = responder (a un correo o mensaje).

questions.question: Could you ____ this email to the manager? (Reenviar).
I forgot to add the ____. (Archivo adjunto).
I will ____ the HR department on this email. (Poner con copia a).
questions.explanation: CC (Carbon Copy) funciona como verbo: I will cc you = te pondré en copia.

questions.question: To write an email to someone, you first click on '____'. (Redactar/Nuevo mensaje).
Be careful when you click 'Reply ____' because everyone will see it. (Responder a todos).
Dear Mr. Smith, I am ____ to inform you that... (Escribiendo).
questions.explanation: I am writing to inform you = le escribo para informarle.

questions.question: A formal way to end an email is 'Best ____'. (Saludos cordiales).
questions.explanation: Best regards o Kind regards = saludos cordiales.

questions.question: Another formal way to end an email is '____,'. (Atentamente/Sinceramente).
I didn't receive it. Please check your ____ folder. (Bandeja de spam/correo no deseado).
questions.explanation: Spam / Junk folder = carpeta de correo no deseado.

questions.question: My ____ is full. I need to delete some emails. (Bandeja de entrada).
I haven't finished writing it. It's saved in my ____ folder. (Borradores).
Who is the ____ of this email? (Destinatario).
Who is the ____ of this email? (Remitente).
Let me ____ you the email I received yesterday. (Reenviar).
questions.explanation: Forward = reenviar (un correo que ya recibiste).

questions.question: Could you ____ the presentation in PDF format? (Adjuntar).
Please ____ this information. (Tomar nota / Estar informado).
questions.explanation: Please note this information = por favor tome nota de esta información.
